verdict.rationale: mParticle is a customer data platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question for this kind of product, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint. The Events API OpenAPI spec and the HTTP APIs are developer building blocks, not an official MCP server, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
